Reads only.

put.summary: Change the sending limits
put.description: Instance admins only. Null means no limit of that kind. The change applies to every email from the next one on: the counter is told at once, and applies the most recently saved limits whatever a worker still has cached (without the counter, a change reaches every worker within 30 seconds). Sends waiting for this Swarm’s own hourly, daily or monthly limit then try again at once, and wait again if the new limit still holds. MAIL_MAX_PER_SECOND, where set on the send worker, still caps perSecond. The row keeps who changed it last and when.

put.summary: Turn a feature on or off for the whole Swarm
put.description: Instance admins only. Only features the list returns are accepted. Off is stored, so an update never turns the feature back on, and the row keeps who changed it last and when. Takes effect within a minute, or six minutes on website pages already in the edge cache.

get.summary: Changes to this Swarm’s settings

Changes to install-wide settings, newest first and `limit` a page (100 unless fewer are asked for), who made them and what they asked for (values of fields named like secrets are not recorded), and whether the whole hash chain still verifies from the first event. Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for older changes.

get.summary: Where website code may run
get.description: Instance admins only. Code owners add to their website (scripts, not CSS) always runs on a publication’s own custom domain. On this Swarm’s own domain it runs only for the workspaces allowed here (`allowed`), or for all of them when everyWorkspace is on. A workspace an instance admin makes is allowed when it is made. `ownedByInstanceAdmin` is for information only and allows nothing by itself, because any owner can make a teammate an owner.

put.description: Instance admins only. Off by default. The row keeps who changed it last and when. Every website’s cached pages are refreshed. Turning it on does not release code that is withheld now: those workspaces are `held`, and their code stays off on this Swarm’s domain until each is allowed by itself.

patch.description: Admins manage the editor, author and viewer roles. Only owners grant or take away the admin role (as with invites and SSO seats) and ownership, and a workspace always keeps one owner. A raise is refused (429) once a seat has changed role 4 times in a day; lowering a role is never held back. The teammate is emailed, and a demotion below admin suspends the API keys and feeds they stand behind and withdraws invites they sent.

patch.description: `pace` sets startCap and growth to a named pace (careful, standard, fast); or set startCap and growth yourself. A ramp still on its first cap takes the new start cap, but never less than what was already sent today. The shared domain allows a start cap up to 500, growth up to 1.5 and a maxCap up to 5,000; an instance admin (`sharedOverride` on the ramp) gets the bounds of a custom domain there and may raise maxCap, audited with instanceAdminOverride. `status` "paused" pauses a warming ramp by hand (`pausedBy` "person") and changes nothing on a ramp that is already paused, so it keeps its reason and who paused it.
